notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: The claw is designed, not converted, so this part has no reference mesh and only its revised render is shown. 930-002_ClawGear.scad draws it and gives its features: it is the drive's gear without the sector, since the fingers' hubs mesh with each other. The page opens cut on its axis. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the render is its output.
